queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Raspberry Pi Imager' AND publisher = 'Raspberry Pi Ltd';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Raspberry Pi Imager' AND publisher = 'Raspberry Pi Ltd' AND version_compare(version, '2.0.8') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'raspberry pi imager.exe');
